short_name: T cell counts do not separate the severity groups
expected: no significant difference between the COVID-19 severity groups
quote: In line with Neumann et al., there was no significant difference in T-helper and cytotoxic T-cell counts between the COVID-19 disease severity groups

short_name: The Th1 subset falls in COVID-19
expected: a significant decrease in all COVID-19 patients against the healthy controls
quote: However, we found the T-helper 1 subset (defined as CD4+ T cells secreting IFN-γ) significantly decreased when comparing all COVID-19 patients to healthy controls

short_name: PD-1 marks the effector T cells
expected: PD-1 highest on CD8 terminally differentiated effector memory cells
quote: Interestingly, PD-1 was highly expressed in most of the effector T cells with a predominance in CD8+ TEMRA cells, attesting for the higher activation of these cells without a strong Th1/Tc1 polarisation

short_name: The CD4 over CD8 ratio rises in COVID-19
expected: a higher ratio in COVID-19 than in the healthy controls and highest in critical disease
quote: However, an increased CD4+/CD8+ T-cell ratio was seen, which was most pronounced in the critical disease group
